title: On Spec R, M ↦ M~ is left adjoint to global sections, fully faithful, and an equivalence onto quasi-coherent modules; it preserves colimits
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $X=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and for an $R$-module $M$ let $\widetilde M$ be the $\mathcal O_X$-module of [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], with $\tau_X:M\to\Gamma(X,\widetilde M)$. Then: (1) $M\mapsto\widetilde M$ is a functor $\mathrm{Mod}_R\to\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] (an $R$-linear $u:M\to N$ goes to the unique $\widetilde u$ with $\widetilde u_X\circ\tau_X=\tau_X\circ u$), left adjoint to $\Gamma(X,-):\Mod(\mathcal O_X)\to\mathrm{Mod}_R$: for every $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$, $\alpha\mapsto\alpha_X\circ\tau_X$ is a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\widetilde M,\mathcal F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_R(M,\Gamma(X,\mathcal F))$, natural in $M$ and $\mathcal F$; (2) the unit $\tau_X:M\to\Gamma(X,\widetilde M)$ is an isomorphism; (3) for every quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ [pqf-def-coherent] the counit $\varepsilon_{\mathcal F}:\widetilde{\Gamma(X,\mathcal F)}\to\mathcal F$ (the map corresponding to $\mathrm{id}_{\Gamma(X,\mathcal F)}$) is an isomorphism; (4) consequently $M\mapsto\widetilde M$ preserves all small colimits: if $(M,(c_i))$ is a colimit of a diagram $(M_i)$ of $R$-modules, then $(\widetilde M,(\widetilde{c_i}))$ is a colimit of $(\widetilde{M_i})$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$.
